title: Emio – The Smiling Man: Famicom Detective Club
subtitle: A smile on a paper bag
summary: Emio – The Smiling Man: Famicom Detective Club is Nintendo and Mages' mystery adventure, released for Switch on 29 August 2024.
body: Emio – The Smiling Man: Famicom Detective Club is Nintendo and Mages' mystery adventure, released for Switch on 29 August 2024. The death of a schoolboy connects the Utsugi Detective Agency to an urban legend involving a man wearing a smiling paper bag. The player works through interviews, locations and evidence to understand the relationship between the current case and older events. The disturbing image provides the question, while the investigation depends on learning about the people who remember it and the circumstances behind their accounts.

The command-based structure follows the Switch remakes of Famicom Detective Club. Asking questions, listening and examining a location provide the means of moving the case forward, with some sections placing Ayumi Tachibana under the player's control. A conversation may need to be revisited when another fact changes what can be asked or understood. The story gradually develops the legend's background, letting the player's view of the case shift as personal histories become clearer. The inquiry moves through testimony rather than treating the frightening figure as an explanation in itself.

Yoshio Sakamoto and Kaori Miyachi wrote the new story, with Sakamoto closely involved in its script and scenes. The project followed the 2021 remakes and became the series' first new game in twenty-seven years. Takeshi Abo composed the music, and the Japanese performances accompany localized text. Its return draws on the series' older method of making a mystery unfold through small conversational discoveries. The paper smile is an immediately memorable image, but the emotional force of the case grows from the human connections uncovered behind it.
